# peakhour_acme_certificate (Resource)

Reads ACME certificate status for a domain and can optionally trigger issuance. The issuance request is asynchronous.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_acme_certificate" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  issue  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `issue` (Boolean) When set to true, triggers an ACME issuance request on create/update (async). Toggle from false→true to re-issue.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_pem` (String) Certificate PEM (computed, may be null).
- `id` (String) ACME certificate identifier (domain/acme_certificate).
- `not_after` (String) Certificate validity end time (computed).
- `not_before` (String) Certificate validity start time (computed).
- `state` (String) ACME certificate state (computed).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_acme_certificate.example example.com
```
